work.author: Charles Wood
work.description: Charles Wood's choral setting of Charles Hamilton Sorley's poem 'Expectans Expectavi', whose title is the Latin incipit of the Offertory antiphon of the Fifteenth Sunday after Pentecost. The setting keeps the Latin title over an English text that begins 'This sanctuary of my soul'. Only the IMSLP catalogue record for it is registered here; the score itself was not retrieved.
